reasoning: Ethereum currently trades near $3,400, only 6% below the $3,600 target. A one-minute high in a full month a year from now is overwhelmingly likely to touch that level barring a catastrophic collapse, yet the market prices it below 1%.
evidence_points: Current ETH price ~$3,400, meaning a ~6% move suffices.
One-minute candle highs capture even brief spikes, drastically lowering the bar.
May 2026 is far enough away that any bullish sentiment or even a dead‑cat bounce in a bear market would likely produce a $3,600 wick.
